description: Land Acquisition - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. Nos. 2086/23 of 30.08.2018 and  2112/49 of 02.03.2019
categorisation: This gazette content is a correction notice specifically related to land acquisition, amending a lot number in a previous land acquisition order. It falls under the Land Gazettes category as it deals with land property matters and corrections to land registration details, with no government personnel changes or structural modifications mentioned beyond the ministerial signature which is procedural for authentication.
